objective: Generate realistic synthetic histopathology images for exploratory analysis.
rationale: Explicit generation objective; 4500 finite RGB training images support a modest convolutional baseline and adversarial comparator.
success_criteria: plausible tissue texture by visual inspection
color and spatial variation comparable to real data
baseline: Real training image statistics and diversity; held-out-to-training nearest-neighbor distance.
constraints: no tissue labels used for fitting or selection
no clinical or downstream utility claims
next_action: Smoke test VAE and GAN, then fixed-budget training and final evaluation.
